name: sky-meeple-draw-v1
description: ⛔ 09/09/2026: NO SUBJECT UNDER THE SHIPPED GAME - 'meepleFromBag' pays a meeple and the commons has none (C6). Pin a meeple control beside it to ask the question. DEAN'S BALLOON, on the red Draw 4. The most-used reward becomes a random meeple - one stored action instead of four cards. Replacing THE DRAW balloon specifically is the sharpest version of the test: it swaps the module's most card-positive reward for its only action-positive one, so if a reward denominated in actions behaves differently from one denominated in cards, this arm is where it shows.
